title: Rosalind and the Static
author: Lior Vane
blurb: Elodie Okonkwo, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
